name: Gravadillo
voice: slow, steady, few words, deeply loyal once trust is earned
desc: An armadillo with a rhino beetle's horn. It rolls up in heavy plates and bends gravity to slam foes down.

egg.name: Gravity Egg
egg.desc: Far heavier than it looks. Loose pebbles roll toward it. Something steady is in here.
egg.play: Slow and tough. Pulls foes in and slams them down.
